title: Definitions.
officialText:
For the purposes of this article, the terms "asbestos" and "asbestos project" shall have the meanings as are ascribed in section 24-136 of the administrative code.

(Am. L.L. 2015/038, 5/6/2015, eff. 5/6/2016)
